Figure 2. A) Overview of the AlphaFold2-generated structure of AdrI. The predicted substrate-binding site is shown in orange. B) Predicted

catalyzed by (F) AdrI and (G) InsA7.

C) Structure of 6 and the proposed mechanism of the cyclization that affords 6.

figure_candidates.caption:
